summary: PLAN_ID toolchain-workflow-repair; CLI requires repository-root, plan-dir, canonical successor output; validates implementation contract and plan-ready state; optional authorized-successor refresh requires maintainer flag and predecessor receipt; hashes bound contract/registry/manifest/freeze/inputs/validation/closure/delta/candidate/tools/predecessor files; updates plan and resume states to implementation-authorized with next_action run-slice; writes authorization receipt and appends completion report; authorizes only implementation-authorized; explicitly excludes completion, acceptance, knowledge publication, bootstrap review, release; receipt contains an apparent malformed predecessor field, an ambiguity requiring aggregator attention.
